short: Flat net sales, slight organic decline
story_fr: Les ventes nettes sont restées stables par rapport à l'année précédente, avec une baisse de 1 % des ventes organiques.
story_en: Net sales were flat versus the year-ago quarter, while organic sales decreased 1%.
quote: Net sales of $1.67 billion were flat versus the year-ago quarter. Organic sales decreased 1%.

story_fr: La marge brute a reculé de 140 points de base, atteignant 43,2 %.
story_en: Gross margin decreased 140 basis points to 43.2% from 44.6% in the year-ago quarter.
quote: Gross margin decreased 140 basis points to 43.2% from 44.6% in the year-ago quarter, primarily driven by higher manufacturing and logistics costs and unfavorable mix, partially offset by cost savings.

story_fr: Le BPA ajusté a progressé de 13 % pour atteindre 1,64 $.
story_en: Adjusted EPS increased 13% to $1.64 from $1.45 in the year-ago quarter.
quote: Adjusted EPS increased 13% to $1.64 from $1.45 in the year-ago quarter, primarily driven by cost savings, lower advertising investments and lower selling and administrative expenses, partially offset by higher manufacturing and logistics costs and unfavorable mix.

story_fr: Le flux de trésorerie net fourni par les opérations a chuté de 59 % à 282 M$.
story_en: Year-to-date net cash provided by operations fell 59% to $282 million.
quote: Year-to-date net cash provided by operations was $282 million compared to $687 million in the year-ago period, representing a 59% decrease, primarily due to the Glad joint venture agreement termination payment.
